editorial:
Imagine living in a tiny town where everyone is super religious, but then people just start killing themselves for no clear reason. You follow a young girl who is tired of all the strict rules and wants to see what the rest of the world is like. She is caught between her family's faith and a creepy mystery that feels like it is swallowing the whole community. The vibe is very heavy and mysterious, making you feel like something evil is hiding just around the corner. It is not a typical jump-scare movie, but it builds a lot of tension that keeps you guessing.

The acting is solid and makes the scary parts feel more real. While the story moves a bit slow at times, the payoff is worth the wait. If you like movies that mess with your head and leave you thinking, you will love this one. You can rent it on Apple TV for a quick watch, but if you really like the dark look of the film, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is the way to go. It looks great in high definition, especially if you are streaming in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video.
endingExplained: You find out that the suicides are not accidents or simple madness. There is a dark, supernatural force affecting the town that feeds on their faith and fear. In the end, the girl realizes that the religious leaders knew more than they let on. The movie wraps up with a chilling realization that the cycle of death is not over, leaving you with a sense that the evil has won.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves psychological horror and religious mysteries.
